topic.title: Organization Level Roles
topic.shortdesc: In Cloud all the content is managed within an organization workspace.

body.p: Users are invited to join an organization and are assigned an organization-level role that determines their administrative privileges within that organization.

There are two organization-level roles:
Member is the default organization-level role.
Users with the Member role can:
Access the organization workspace
Perform actions permitted by their assigned user role
Admin is the organization-level administrative role. The user who creates the organization receives automatically this role.
Users with this role can:
Edit organization settings
Manage organization users (invite, remove, or update users)
Assign organization-level roles
Manage license allocation within the organization
